memories.content: The user agreed to lead Cedar Observatory volunteers on Saturday mornings, but Saturday later became unavailable; Sunday mornings are now confirmed. Weekday evenings remain unavailable because of choir.

For the telescope restoration, the user ordered a brass focusing knob that fits the 1978 instrument. The club decided to keep the telescope's original blue finish rather than repaint it black, to preserve its history.
The user's cousin Ivo is joining the spring train trip. They chose May instead of April so the coastal line will be running.
